definitions.sample: Successful paired runs only; failures/cancellations remain in records and requested denominator.
definitions.difference: Treatment completed − Baseline completed, same seed and config.
definitions.sd: Sample SD with n−1; null for fewer than 2 successful pairs.
definitions.improvement: Count of strictly positive increments / successful pairs; simulation statistic, not real-world probability.
definitions.pooledCpic: Sum Treatment settled voucher spend / sum ALL paired increments; null if denominator ≤0.
definitions.nullable: Wait/utilization/budget utilization use their own valid counts; nulls are never replaced with zero.
definitions.uncertainty: Empirical seed variation under PoC assumptions; no causal or commercial claim.

source: Actual local FastAPI / OSRM MLD; no mocks
